set.pl: Just upstream (south) of the Niles dam on the St Joseph River, about 3/4 mile south of Main St (1889 Sanborn sheet 6); the river flows north here, so 'above the dam' is the south side
pinev: 1889 Sanborn, Niles, sheet 6: DAM across the St Joseph between the Michigan Wood Pulp Co. and the Ohio Paper Co. mills, '3/4 mile S. of Main St'.

2015 1 m LiDAR: the flattened river surface steps up about 4.2 m (194.7 m to 198.9 m) at about 41.8175, -86.2588, which is the dam; pin about 150 m upstream of it. Moved from a pin about 2 km north, off the river.

tw-mi-niles-dam-french-war-cache.t: The dam: the 1889 Sanborn map shows it about 3/4 mile south of Main St between the pulp and paper mills, and the LiDAR water surface steps up about 4 m there; 'just above the dam' is the stretch upstream (south) of it.
src: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Niles, Michigan, Oct 1889, sheet 6 (Library of Congress sanborn04129_002)

tw-mn-henderson-ritter-beer-casks.t: The 1894 Sanborn map (sheet 1) shows the Jno. Enes Brewery about 1/2 mile south of the post office, built against the hill beside the road up the bluff, with ice houses and a malt house; whether this was Ritter's earlier brewery is not yet confirmed, so the pin stays on the town.
src: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Henderson, Minnesota, June 1894, sheet 1 (Library of Congress sanborn04308_001)
